basics.description: Deploy a **Flexible-orchestration Linux VMSS** from the CrowdStrike golden image built in Step 1. Each instance registers its own unique AID on first boot.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Region for the VMSS and networking.

basics.name: adminUsername
basics.label: Admin username
basics.toolTip: Local administrator username for the Linux instances.

validations.message: 3-32 chars, lowercase letters/digits/_/-, must not start with a digit.

basics.name: adminPassword
basics.toolTip: Local administrator password. Azure Linux requires 6-72 chars with at least 3 of: lowercase, uppercase, digit, special character.

constraints.validationMessage: 12-72 chars with at least one lowercase, one uppercase, and one digit.

elements.name: keyVaultName
elements.label: Key Vault name
elements.toolTip: The Key Vault created by Step 1 (shown in Step 1's deployment outputs).

validations.message: 3-24 chars, start with a letter, alphanumeric/hyphen, no trailing hyphen.

elements.name: imageVersion
elements.label: Image version
elements.toolTip: Golden image version to deploy. Use 'latest' for the newest published version or pin an exact version.

validations.message: Use 'latest' or an exact version like 1.0.0.

elements.name: imageDefinitionName
elements.label: Image definition name
elements.toolTip: The image definition created by Step 1 (shown in Step 1's outputs as imageDefinitionName). Must match exactly.

validations.message: Enter the image definition name from Step 1 (no spaces).

elements.name: vmSize
elements.label: VM size
elements.toolTip: Size for the scale set instances.

elements.name: instanceCount
elements.label: Instance count
elements.toolTip: Number of VM instances in the scale set.
